name: RuleArena
description: RuleArena is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to follow complex, real-world rules in reasoning across practical domains such as airline baggage fees, NBA transactions, and tax regulations. It tests long-context understanding, logical reasoning, and accurate math computation in authentic scenarios beyond standard first-order logic representations.
reputation: A new benchmark that is gaining attention for testing rule-following and long-context reasoning in realistic domains, but it is not yet broadly established as a standard suite.
notes: Focuses on real-world rule-guided reasoning; highlights LLM limitations in rule identification and math computation; shows performance boost with external tools.
